title: Cache + LCP root-cause closure

cache.finding: Published WordPress posts with comment_status=open are consistently returned with X-LiteSpeed-Cache-Control: no-cache, while cacheable controls such as the homepage return X-LiteSpeed-Cache: hit.
cache.causal_ab: On post 143698, closing comments changed cache behavior; restoring comments=open restored no-cache. This makes comment_status/open-comments path the verified trigger.
cache.controls: Homepage repeatedly HIT; product/category/dynamic Woo routes retain their independent cache rules.
ruled_out: Carsp_plugin_Wrench: full targeted source scan found no cache/no-cache hooks
Code Snippets: active snippets do not target calculator/posts; shop override is /shop only
Irankala theme sandbox: no DONOTCACHEPAGE/nocache_headers/session_start/comments_array direct matches
WooCommerce WC_Cache_Helper::prevent_caching: current code only targets cart/checkout/my-account page IDs
Digits: previous A/B with security devices off did not restore cache; 178-file cache signature scan returned no matches
LiteSpeed commenter pending path: calculator has no pending/approved comments; only 3 trash rows; probe sends an empty Cookie header
LiteSpeed ESI comment form is enabled (litespeed.conf.esi-cache_commform=1)
cache.source_attribution_note: The exact third-party runtime callback that flips LiteSpeed Control to non-cacheable is not statically attributable through the guarded read-only file interfaces. Determining the precise callback would require runtime hook instrumentation/arbitrary diagnostic code, which is intentionally outside the guarded production policy. The trigger itself is causally verified by reversible A/B evidence.

lcp.alt: بنر لوله و اتصالات پلیمری کشاورزی کشاورز بیست
lcp.payload_note: Earlier baseline measured roughly 3.08 MB total with roughly 2.23 MB images; large homepage images remain a secondary performance pressure.

next_phase_hypotheses: Cache: apply a narrowly scoped, reversible public-cache override only to safe anonymous GET post requests after excluding logged-in/AJAX/query-sensitive/dynamic routes; verify comments and review submission remain functional.
LCP: make the first visible slider image eager/high-priority and avoid lazy-loading it; then re-run Lighthouse and cache matrix.
